text:
marta: Heads up — seeing steady RSS growth on long streaming sessions with tool loops. 12h run shows +2.3GB and trend keeps going. Repro steps: start a streaming chat, trigger the tool-loop path repeatedly (~800 token loops). Suspect an anchor-release race in the KV cache (pins not being released).

josh: Can you paste smaps / pprof output? even a small snippet helps.

marta: pasted pprof heap sample and a few smaps lines:
```
pprof: heap inuse_objects=... samples: growth concentrated in kv_entry allocations
#0  0x7f2...  kv_entry_hold_count++  (runtime)
#1  0x7f3...  tool_loop_pin_entry
#2  0x7f4...  streaming_append_token

/proc/12345/smaps: RSS: 320MB -> 2.5GB over 12h (gradual)
```

rachel: notable — we rolled the kernel-selector micro-optim last week (commit abc123) that changed a fast-path and pin semantics for fused attention shards. Could be an interaction but not sure. :eyes: 

amir: quick check: evict thread metrics look odd. evict.loop.count = 0 on affected hosts. either the evict scheduler isn't running or the scan returns nothing to reclaim.

sree: I repro'd locally and toggled KV_EVICT_INTERVAL=60s. eviction wakes but reclaimed bytes are tiny. I instrumented page_chain length: start 430 -> 1120 over 6h. seems like pages get unlinked from active lists but remain pinned by entries.

marta: added temporary logging for per-entry pinned_until and pin_source. most pins are pin_source=TOOL_LOOP and pinned_until is far in the future. pin release code path hits but early-return if refcount>1. logs: 
```
kv_entry id=0x7fa pinned_until=1710000000 pin_source=TOOL_LOOP refcount=3
kv_entry id=0x7fb pinned_until=1710000100 pin_source=TOOL_LOOP refcount=4
```

josh: maybe batching heuristics are setting keep_alive for tool loop prefixes. search for keep_alive toggle in batch heuristic.

rachel: found it — commit def456 introduced tool_loop_keepalive=true by default in batch heuristic to reduce re-fetchs. That means entries are explicitly marked to survive eviction.

amir: that explains why evict_scan reclaims little. Two quick mitigation ideas: revert the keepalive default for tool loops, and make evict_scan force-clear entries with pin_source=TOOL_LOOP older than X. Both are low-risk.

marta: rolled a canary with keepalive reverted + evict_scan N=100 forced. results after 24h: no growth, memory stable; previous canary had steady climb. latency impact: <5% p50 increase on heavy session tests. numbers: peak delta -2.2GB vs +2.3GB previously.

ci-bot: deploy canary to shard-12 succeeded :white_check_mark:

sree: created issue eng-runtime#487 — "anchor-release race: tool_loop keepalive interaction" and assigned to eng-runtime.

josh: next engineering steps: instrument where pins are acquired to capture stack and reason for non-zero refcounts; add unit test for pin TTL expiry; run long-run stress on canary for 7 days.

rachel: I'll open the PR to revert def456 and include test coverage. also going to add a small metric: kv_pinned_by_source{source=TOOL_LOOP} so we can alert on slope.

amir: +1. one caution: kernel-selector tweak (abc123) may have a separate perf regression path — I'll keep a patch queued for that if we see latency regressions after revert.

marta: thanks all. leaving the temporary logging in for 48h then turning it into a lightweight metric. cc @sre for ops monitoring.

josh: good find. keeping this thread as the central triage. :thumbsup:
